alerts.subject: [C10-HIGH] 10y Real Yield restrictive: 2.78% ≥ 2.50%
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-10-15
Current:  2.78%
Stress ≥: 2.50%

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year US real (TIPS) yield read 2.78% on 2026-10-15. That is above C10's 2.5% stress level, up from 2.84% on 10-14.

内容:
2026-10-15 美国 10 年期实际利率（TIPS）为 2.78%，高于 C10 设定的 2.5% 压力线。10-14 为 2.84%。

Why it matters:
A real yield near 2.8% raises the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex payoffs and makes debt-funded data-center buildouts more expensive. Liquidity this tight compresses the multiples the AI trade depends on, even without a credit event. The 2.84% → 2.78% dip is noise; the level is the signal.

影响:
实际利率在 2.8% 左右，抬高了 AI capex 远期回报的折现率，靠举债建数据中心也更贵。流动性这么紧，就算没有信用事件，AI 交易依赖的估值倍数也会被压缩。2.84% 到 2.78% 的小幅回落是噪音，要看的是绝对水平。

90d low:  2.14%
Move:     +64bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The US 10-year real (TIPS) yield rose to 2.78% on 2026-10-15. That is 0.64 pp above its trailing-90-day low of 2.14%.

内容:
2026-10-15，美国 10 年期实际利率（TIPS 收益率）升至 2.78%，比过去 90 天低点 2.14% 高出 0.64 个百分点。

Why it matters:
Higher real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI growth stories and make debt-funded data-center buildouts more expensive. A rise of 0.64 pp off the low tightens financial conditions just as hyperscalers and neoclouds lean harder on credit markets to pay for capex.

影响:
实际利率越高，长久期 AI 增长故事的估值折现率越高，靠举债建数据中心的成本也越高。此刻超大规模厂商和 neocloud 正越来越依赖信贷市场为 capex 融资，实际利率从低点抬升 0.64 个百分点，等于在这个时点收紧了金融条件。

美国 2026-09 的 CPI 同比为 4.02%，高于 C8 的 3.5% 触发线，比 2026-08 的 3.7% 又升了一截（来源：https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CPIAUCSL）。

Why it matters:
Inflation above 4% makes Fed rate cuts less likely and keeps discount rates high. That hurts long-duration AI-infrastructure equities most, because their valuations rest on payback years away. Higher rates also make debt-funded capex, such as neocloud GPU loans and hyperscaler bond issuance, more expensive to roll.

影响:
通胀破 4%，美联储降息的可能性变小，贴现率会维持在高位。AI 基础设施股的估值靠的是好几年后才回本，所以受伤最重。利率高了，靠举债撑的 capex 续借成本也跟着涨，比如 neocloud 的 GPU 贷款和超大规模厂商发的债。

美国 CPI 同比连续第二个月上升：2026 年 7 月 3.54%，8 月 3.71%，9 月 4.02%，已高于 C8 的 3.5% 触发线。

Why it matters:
Inflation that keeps speeding up past 4% leaves the Fed no room to cut rates, and may push it toward hikes. Higher rates raise the discount rate on long-duration AI equities and the cost of the debt now funding hyperscaler and neocloud capex. Core PCE was already 3.0% as of August (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/PCEPILFE), so this is broad inflation, not a one-off.

影响:
通胀突破 4% 而且还在加速，Fed 没法降息，甚至可能被逼着加息。利率一高，长久期 AI 股票的折现率跟着上去，超大规模厂商和 neocloud 靠借钱撑起来的 capex 也更贵。8 月 core PCE 已经是 3.0%（https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/PCEPILFE），说明通胀是全面的，不是单月扰动。

What this means:
The 10-year Treasury real (TIPS) yield hit 2.91% on 2026-10-09, up 0.80 pp from its trailing-90-day low of 2.11%.

内容:
10 年期美债实际收益率（TIPS）在 2026-10-09 升至 2.91%，比近 90 天低点 2.11% 高出 0.80 pp。

Why it matters:
Higher real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI equities, whose valuations depend on cash flows far in the future. They also make it more expensive to borrow for the debt-funded share of AI capex, such as neocloud loans and hyperscaler bond issues. A 0.80 pp rise in under three months is fast enough to tighten liquidity across the AI-infrastructure trade.

影响:
实际利率上升会抬高贴现率。AI 相关股票的估值主要靠远期现金流，所以受压最大。AI capex 里靠举债的那部分也会更贵，比如 neocloud 的贷款和超大规模厂商发的债。不到三个月涨了 0.80 pp，速度够快，会让整个 AI 基础设施交易的流动性收紧。

alerts.subject: [C6-MED] Global smartphone shipments hit 14-year low as memory chip shortage drives up phone prices - India Today
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22HBM%22+OR+%22memory+chip%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:13:57 GMT Link: https://news.google.?oc=5 Global smartphone shipments hit 14-year low as memory chip shortage drives up phone prices - India Today Global smartphone shipments hit 14-year low as memory chip shortage drives up phone prices  India Today ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: Global smartphone shipments fell to a 14-year low, and the headline blames a memory chip shortage that is pushing phone prices up. 内容: 全球智能手机出货量跌到 14 年来最低。报道认为原因是内存芯片短缺推高了手机价格。 Why it matters: Memory makers are steering DRAM/NAND capacity toward AI servers and HBM, and consumer devices are absorbing the cost. That shows AI capex is still pulling supply tight. Shortage-driven price spikes plus collapsing end demand usually mark a memory cycle near its peak: if AI orders slow, the industry is left with capacity built for a demand level that consumer markets have already stopped supporting. 影响: 内存厂商把 DRAM/NAND 产能往 AI 服务器和 HBM 倾斜，涨价的成本落到了消费电子头上。这说明 AI capex 仍在把供给吃紧。不过，短缺带来的涨价加上终端需求萎缩，通常意味着内存周期接近顶部。一旦 AI 订单放缓，行业手里的产能是按一个消费端已经撑不住的需求水平建的。

It matters only in a roundabout way: SpaceX expanding into telecom supports the growth premium priced into its valuation, and that premium is what forced index inclusion and passive flows will have to absorb. 影响: 这条是竞争和业务新闻，不涉及指数纳入资金流或解禁，对 SPCX 的被动买盘和解禁抛压没有直接信号。它只有间接意义：SpaceX 进军电信，支撑了估值里的增长溢价，而被动资金和指数纳入最终要接下的正是这份溢价。

The headline gives no figures for the loss or the price increase. 内容: 一条标题称，Samsung 手机业务 Q3 亏损扩大，原因是内存价格飙升。标题没有给出亏损额或涨价幅度。 Why it matters: This is a shortage signal, not a bust signal. AI demand for HBM and server DRAM is pulling capacity away from commodity memory, and the cost spike is now squeezing downstream device makers. Memory price surges near cycle peaks have historically led to capacity overbuilds, so this matters for C6 because the next leg is often oversupply. 影响: 这是短缺信号，不是崩盘信号。AI 对 HBM 和服务器 DRAM 的需求把产能从普通内存挤走，成本上涨已经压到下游终端厂商身上。历史上，周期高点附近的内存涨价常常引来产能过度扩张，所以 C6 要盯的是下一步往往会出现的供过于求。

The tracker tagged it C6_PRICE_SURGE: the shortage term sits next to a memory term. 内容: 一条新闻（来源只标为 "News and Statistics"）称，Apple 因内存芯片短缺把 iPhone 18 Pro 的订单砍了 15-20%。tracker 把它标成 C6_PRICE_SURGE：短缺一词紧挨着内存词。 Why it matters: This is the opposite of oversupply stress: AI demand for HBM and server DRAM is squeezing memory supply and prices hard enough that consumer devices lose allocation. alerts.subject: [C10-HIGH] 10y Real Yield restrictive: 2.87% ≥ 2.50%
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-10-08
Current:  2.87%
Stress ≥: 2.50%

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year US real (TIPS) yield printed 2.87% on 2026-10-08, above the tracker's 2.5% stress level. It is slightly below the 2.92% reading on 2026-10-07.

内容:
10 年期美国实际利率（TIPS 收益率）2026-10-08 报 2.87%，高于 tracker 设定的 2.5% 压力线，比 2026-10-07 的 2.92% 略低。

Why it matters:
A real yield near 2.9% raises the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex payoffs and makes debt-funded data-center buildouts more expensive. The 2.5% stress line is breached by 0.37pp, so the liquidity backdrop is still tight even after a small one-day dip.

影响:
实际利率在 2.9% 附近，AI capex 这类回报周期长的投入折现率被抬高，靠举债建数据中心的成本也跟着变贵。2.87% 比 2.5% 压力线高出 0.37pp，单日小幅回落也没改变流动性偏紧的局面。

Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)

Current:  2.87%
90d low:  2.07%
Move:     +80bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The US 10-year real (TIPS) yield hit 2.87% on 2026-10-08. That is 0.80 pp above its trailing-90-day low of 2.07%.

内容:
美国 10 年期实际利率（TIPS 收益率）在 2026-10-08 升至 2.87%，比过去 90 天低点 2.07% 高出 0.80 个百分点。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration growth equities and make debt-funded AI capex more expensive to finance. A real yield near 2.9% is restrictive territory. It squeezes the valuation multiples that rely on payback in distant years, and pressures the neocloud and hyperscaler bond issuance funding the buildout.

影响:

AI servers, especially HBM, are pulling DRAM/NAND capacity away from consumer devices, so AI demand is still crowding out other buyers rather than fading. The risk is downstream: higher memory costs cut handset volumes and squeeze margins outside AI. If AI orders later slow while the industry is still running at shortage-level capacity, prices can reverse quickly. 影响: 这是短缺信号，不是过剩信号。AI 服务器（尤其是 HBM）在抢 DRAM/NAND 产能，消费电子拿到的份额变少，说明 AI 需求还在挤占其他买家，没有退潮。风险在下游：内存成本上升会压低手机出货量，也会挤压 AI 以外业务的利润。如果之后 AI 订单放缓，而行业产能还按短缺时的水平在跑，价格可能很快反转。

alerts.subject: [C10-HIGH] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.92% (+85bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-10-07
Current:  2.92%
90d low:  2.07%
Move:     +85bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The US 10-year real (TIPS) yield rose to 2.92% on 2026-10-07, up 0.85 pp from its trailing-90-day low of 2.07%.

内容:
美国 10 年期实际收益率（TIPS）在 2026-10-07 升至 2.92%，比过去 90 天低点 2.07% 高出 0.85 个百分点。

Why it matters:
Higher real yields raise the discount rate on long-dated AI payoffs and make debt-funded capex more expensive. A real yield near 3% tightens financial conditions and hits high-multiple AI names and leveraged neoclouds hardest. That pressure lands on the most stretched parts of the buildout first.

影响:
实际收益率上升，远期 AI 回报的折现率随之抬高，靠举债撑的 capex 也更贵。实际利率接近 3% 会收紧金融条件，首先压的是高估值 AI 股和高杠杆 neocloud。这轮建设里最紧绷的环节会最先受压。

A real yield near 3% raises the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex payoffs and makes debt-funded data-center buildouts more expensive to carry. Source: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DFII10

影响:
实际收益率接近 3% 会抬高折现率，压低 AI capex 远期回报的现值；靠借债建数据中心的持有成本也跟着上升。收益率一直压在压力线上方，收入还没跟上时，杠杆最重的环节（neocloud、靠信贷撑的 capex）流动性会先变紧。来源：https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DFII10

alerts.subject: [C10-HIGH] 10y Real Yield restrictive: 2.91% ≥ 2.50%
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-10-06
Current:  2.91%
Stress ≥: 2.50%

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year Treasury real (TIPS) yield printed 2.91% on 2026-10-06, above C10's 2.5% stress level; the prior reading was 2.95% on 2026-10-05.

内容:
10 年期美债实际收益率（TIPS）2026-10-06 报 2.91%，高于 C10 设定的 2.5% 压力线；前一读数为 2026-10-05 的 2.95%。

Why it matters:
A real yield near 3% raises the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex payoffs, so equity valuations that rest on profits years away get squeezed. It also makes debt-funded data-center and neocloud buildouts more expensive to finance. At 2.91% it sits 0.41pp over the trigger, short of the 2× escalation that would make it HIGH.

影响:
实际利率接近 3%，会抬高远期 AI capex 回报的折现率，靠多年后才兑现利润撑起的估值因此受压。数据中心和 neocloud 靠举债扩张，融资成本也跟着变贵。2.91% 比压力线高 0.41pp，还没到升为 HIGH 所需的 2 倍触发幅度。

alerts.subject: [C10-HIGH] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.91% (+84bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-10-06
Current:  2.91%
90d low:  2.07%
Move:     +84bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (TIPS) yield rose to 2.91% on 2026-10-06, up 0.84 pp from its trailing-90-day low of 2.07%.

内容:
10 年期美债实际收益率（TIPS）2026-10-06 升到 2.91%，比过去 90 天低点 2.07% 高了 0.84 个百分点。

Why it matters:
Higher real yields raise the discount rate on long-dated AI payoffs and make debt-funded capex more expensive, at the point when hyperscalers and neoclouds are leaning more on borrowing. A move of about 84 bp in three months tightens financial conditions and squeezes long-duration AI equities and their credit.

影响:

alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22DRAM%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 01:04:00 GMT Link: https://news.google.?oc=5 PRE-MARKET TAIWAN AND SINGAPORE STOCKS NEWS: Nanya Technology (2408 TT) reportedly notified customers of another DRAM contract price increase of up to 20%, according to industry sources - Newsquawk PRE-MARKET TAIWAN AND SINGAPORE STOCKS NEWS: Nanya Technology (2408 TT) reportedly notified customers of another DRAM contract price increase of up to 20%, according to industry sources  Newsquawk ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: Nanya Technology (2408 TT) has reportedly told customers it will raise DRAM contract prices again, by up to 20%, according to industry sources. 内容: 据业内消息，南亚科 Nanya Technology (2408 TT) 通知客户，DRAM 合约价将再次上调，最高涨 20%。 Why it matters: A second round of hikes this large points to a tight DRAM supply, likely because AI and HBM demand is soaking up wafer capacity that would otherwise make commodity DRAM. alerts.subject: [C10-HIGH] 10y Real Yield restrictive: 2.95% ≥ 2.50%
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-10-05
Current:  2.95%
Stress ≥: 2.50%

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year US real (TIPS) yield printed 2.95% on 2026-10-05, above C10's 2.5% stress level and up from 2.92% on 2026-10-02.

内容:
美国 10 年期实际利率（TIPS 收益率）2026-10-05 报 2.95%，高于 C10 设定的 2.5% 压力线，较 2026-10-02 的 2.92% 继续上行。

Why it matters:
A near-3% real yield raises the discount rate on long-duration AI cash flows that are still years away, which compresses the valuations that support the capex story. It also makes debt-funded data-center buildouts more expensive to finance. Sustained real-rate pressure is the macro squeeze that has historically ended speculative capex cycles.

影响:
实际利率逼近 3%，等于抬高了对 AI 远期现金流的折现率。这些收入大多还要好几年才兑现，支撑 capex 叙事的估值会被压缩。靠举债建数据中心的融资成本也跟着上升。实际利率持续走高，历史上就是终结投机性资本开支周期的宏观挤压。

美国 10 年期实际收益率（TIPS）在 2026-10-05 升至 2.95%，比过去 90 天低点 2.06% 高出 0.89 个百分点。

Why it matters:
Higher real yields raise the discount rate on long-dated AI-capex payoffs and make funding more expensive, which hits the most speculative, cash-burning names and the debt-funded build-out hardest. A near-90bp move in three months tightens liquidity, and that has historically come before de-rating of long-duration growth equities. (FRED DFII10 read 2.92% on 2026-10-02, so the move is still holding: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DFII10)

影响:
